definitions.explanation: Extending or prolonging a person's life, especially through medical intervention. Also used figuratively for extending the lifespan of organizations, systems, or objects.

examples.japanese: {延命|えんめい}⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧べき⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
{延命|えんめい}⟦{措置|そち}→措置：05519_sochi⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}った→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧。

⟦{老朽化|ろうきゅうか}→老朽化：07646_roukyuuka⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{延命|えんめい}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われ→行う：01238_okonau⟧、あと20⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{見通|みとお}し→見通し：10566_mitooshi⟧だ。
examples.english: Life-extension work was carried out on the aging bridge, and it is expected to last another 20 years.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly encountered in medical contexts as {延命|えんめい}⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧ (life-prolonging treatment) or {延命|えんめい}⟦{措置|そち}→措置：05519_sochi⟧ (life-sustaining measures), which are frequently discussed in the context of end-of-life care and bioethics in Japan. Also used figuratively for infrastructure, equipment, and organizations: ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{延命|えんめい} (extending the life of a building).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {延命|えんめい}⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧: life-prolonging treatment
- {延命|えんめい}⟦{措置|そち}→措置：05519_sochi⟧: life-sustaining measures
- {延命|えんめい}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧: life-extension construction
- {延命|えんめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{図|はか}る→図る：12006_hakaru⟧: aim to extend the lifespan
